name: riggermortis
display_name: riggermortis — local, rig-agnostic posing & animation for Blender
description: MCP server + Blender add-on: drop a rigged model and a reference image and get the pose applied; drop a video job and get a foot-locked, walk-in-place animation. Drives Blender through domain tools with structured policy refusals. No cloud, no accounts, no uploads, ever.

transport.session_bridge: opt-in loopback TCP on 127.0.0.1 ONLY; starts solely with --session-port AND --session-token

capabilities.session_bridge: per-process: true only when the bridge flags are given

notes: This manifest is PROJECT metadata pinned by core/tests/test_mcp_server.py (tools and version must match the server module exactly). Official MCP registry submission fields get filled at submission time — account-bound, see docs/PUBLISHING.md.
